name: Ultimate Mosh of The Year IV
description: Ultimate Mosh of The Year IV is a music event featuring death metal, grindcore, and brutal music. The event will host three bands: HOLOCAUSTO CANIBAL, CRUCIVORE, and MANGUALDE.
longDescription:
Ultimate Mosh of The Year IV is a music event scheduled for Saturday, December 26, 2026, at Ferro Bar in Porto. The night promises a lineup of death metal, grindcore, and brutal music.

Three bands are confirmed to perform: HOLOCAUSTO CANIBAL, CRUCIVORE, and MANGUALDE. The event starts at 9:30 PM and has a duration of 141 minutes with no interval. Tickets are priced at 10€ and are available for attendees aged 16 and over.
